AccessTokenInput.description: Administrator request to issue an expiring machine credential.

AccessTokenView.description: Safe credential metadata, with no secret or hash.

tokenId.description: Integration credential identifier, never its secret.

targetType.description: Stable kind of the affected business object; blank on historical v1 entries.

targetId.description: Identifier retained even after the target is deleted.

targetName.description: Safe object name at the time of the operation; never credentials or body text.

AuditEntry.description: Successful write audit; never stores passwords or content.

CaptchaView.description: Single-use login challenge, image and validity period; never includes its answer.

visitorId.description: Browser identity for retry ownership; not a verified person.

contentId.description: Originating content, when submitted from an article or page.

contact.description: Phone, email or WeChat handle provided for a reply.

consentedAt.description: Customer agreed to use the provided details for this inquiry.

CustomerLead.description: Private customer inquiry with optimistic follow-up state.

IntegrationPublication.description: Published state and its site-relative reading address.

IssuedAccessToken.description: The secret is returned only in this issuance response.

LeadInput.description: Customer-supplied inquiry; contact data never appears in its receipt.

LeadUpdateInput.description: Private follow-up changes with optimistic concurrency.

MenuTarget.description: One selectable published content or archive destination.

MenuView.description: Resolved navigation destination; unavailable items are administrative only.

contentId.description: Published content identity, empty for listing pages.

path.description: Canonical local page path without query strings.

title.description: Public title when the visit was accepted.

source.description: Campaign label or external referring hostname, never the full referring URL.

activeSeconds.description: Cumulative visible seconds, bounded by elapsed server time and four hours.

depth.description: Maximum visible article depth, between zero and one hundred.

PageVisit.description: One visible page lifecycle; its primary key also deduplicates retries.

PageVisitReceipt.description: Accepted navigation and current public article count.

PopularContent.description: Popular article with period reading metrics.

ReadingInput.description: Absolute, monotonic reading observations for one page lifecycle.

subtitle.description: Short introduction displayed with the site identity.

language.description: Primary content language, not an interface translation setting.

blockSearchEngines.description: Request search engines to exclude public pages from indexing.

commentsEnabled.description: Whether public comments can be read and submitted.

commentsRequireLogin.description: Require an existing enabled account for comment submission.

SiteSettings.description: Site metadata stored in the selected database.

ThemeApplyInput.description: Atomically save this profile and activate it.

ThemeDefinition.description: One packaged theme and its independent saved options.

ThemesView.description: Administrative snapshot used for optimistic writes.

TrafficBucket.description: Counts for one dimension or calendar day.

TrafficReport.description: Period and lifetime metrics plus database-aggregated chart series.

TrafficTotals.description: Database aggregate of page counts and cumulative reading samples.

UserInput.description: Account administration input; password optional on edit.

UserView.description: Account information safe for the browser.

VersionInput.description: Version required for publish, unpublish and delete.

VisitEventInput.description: One user-initiated action with a retry identifier.

VisitInput.description: Visible browser navigation with a client-generated retry identifier.

lastSeenAt.description: Most recent accepted page visit in UTC.

VisitorProfile.description: First-party pseudonymous browser profile; contains no IP or contact details.

VisitReceipt.description: Accepted visit identifier; empty means intentionally excluded from telemetry.

IntegrationToken.description: Expiring CMS access token issued by an administrator. HTTPS required; no cookie or CSRF token is used on integration endpoints.
